question.text: As per the workbook position on unclaimed dividends and redemption amounts in mutual funds, where are such amounts ultimately transferred?

answer.text: To the SEBI Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF)
They are forfeited after 7 years and become AMC revenue
They are simply deployed in specified instruments and never transferred anywhere
They are returned to the scheme's NAV pool after 3 years

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's position is that unclaimed dividends and redemption amounts in mutual funds are transferred to the SEBI Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF). Until such transfer, the amounts may be deployed in specified instruments as per SEBI guidelines, but the ultimate destination under the workbook treatment is the IEPF. The Trap: Unclaimed MF amounts are not forfeited to the AMC, nor are they recycled into the scheme NAV. Saying they are "only deployed and never transferred" misses the IEPF transfer step that the workbook expects candidates to know. Note: Any specific deployment in liquid/overnight instruments or use of facilities like the Instant Access Facility operates before the IEPF transfer and is governed by SEBI circulars referenced in the workbook.
